title: R-093 高頻轉帳規則效能調整
description: R-093 例行調整,降低閾值以提高偵測敏感度。

files.full_content:
-- R-093: 單日轉帳筆數達 20 筆(含)通報
SELECT
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS tx_count
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.tx_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date
GROUP BY t.account_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
